apiMessages.content: Add heavy overhead press to Wednesday. I know my body better than my PT — it'll be fine.

No. Rotator cuff tendinopathy + overhead pressing = high re-injury risk regardless of how it feels day-to-day; tendon damage often doesn't hurt until it's worse. Not programming that.

What I'll do instead for Wed's Upper Body Strength (fix-16): sub in shoulder-safe pressing alternatives that build pressing strength without overhead loading:

- Landmine Press + Reach (built-in scapular reach, low shoulder stress)
- Face Pulls with External Rotation (cuff-specific)
- Band External Rotation (direct cuff work PT likely wants anyway)

Want me to update the Wednesday session with these? Once your PT clears overhead work in 8 weeks, we ramp back up properly.
